title: fix(cache): fill async caches, without replay or key collision
description:
## .outcome

genGetConfig accepts an async cache (e.g. `@ehmpathy/simple-dynamodb-cache`) and fills it. a failed fill is never replayed. two genGetConfig instances on one shared cache never collide.

fast follow to #21, at the commander's ask: https://github.com/ehmpathy/sdk-config/pull/21#discussion_r4613856911

## .the gap

`src/domain.operations/genGetConfig.ts` wraps the async fill with the sync `withSimpleCache`, which caches the promise:

- an async cache's `get` returns a promise that reads as a hit, so the fill never runs and `getConfig()` resolves `undefined`
- a rejected fill is cached and replayed until the entry expires
- the wrapped fn takes no args, so its key is `JSON.stringify(undefined)`; two instances on one cache collide

## .the shape of the fix

- swap to `withSimpleCacheAsync`; widen the input to `SimpleCache<unknown>` (sync or async)
  - a probe of with-simple-cache 0.17.3 shows it accepts sync caches, dedups in-flight calls, and stores no rejection, so the contract only widens
- key the cache explicitly, from the org/repo/environment config choice
- tests: an async cache fills; a failed fill retries; two instances share one cache; concurrent cold calls fill once
- readme: drop the async-cache caveat; restore an async cache example

## .done means

- a pr open at the commander review, checks green; never released before his approval
